# The gate checks: declared crates = workspace members (+ the root package); a `pending` crate is
# not yet a member; no full/emitted crate has a non-dev dependency on an unscanned or pending
# crate; every third-party non-dev dependency of a full crate is declared here; the `include!`
# list is exact; every .rs under a scanned src/ is reached by the module walk, cfg-excluded, or
# declared `unreached`. The baseline modes of the scanned crates also live in gate code
# (BASELINE_SCANNED), so this file can add crates but cannot demote one.
